name: firstcontact
description: A welcoming, open-source bridge between overlooked founders and thoughtful investors worldwide.

scripts.check: tsc --noEmit --incremental false && vitest run && eslint . && next build

//overrides: Transitive dependencies of next/vite carrying known-high advisories, forced to their fixed releases rather than suppressed in the audit. Remove an entry once the parent package requires the fixed version itself. brace-expansion is deliberately NOT overridden here: its only fix is an API break that eslint's minimatch 3.x cannot consume, so it is excluded by advisory id in the CI audit job instead.
//dependencies: Pinned to exact versions on purpose: a fresh `bun install` without the lockfile must resolve to the versions CI verified, and Dependabot proposes upgrades as reviewable PRs instead of them arriving silently.
